note: SKNode's iOS 9 member: the move to a new parent. The iOS 7 surface is in ios7.json, the iOS 8 subscript in ios8.json, and the rest of SpriteKit's iOS 9 surface (SKAttribute, SKAttributeValue) has no row yet.

entries.source: spec/SpriteKit/declarations.tsv, the SKNode member; spec/SpriteKit/declarations.tsv, (im)moveToParent:, ios=9.0
entries.effect: the node leaves its parent and joins the new one as its last child (measured: after moveToParent of c to a, a lists [x, c]); built in SpriteKit9.m as removeFromParent then addChild:. The failure cases are unmeasured
